patch.summary:
Thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in hr, but documented company-size audiences diverge.

Both sit in hr, but documented company-size audiences diverge. Choose Gusto only if your buying job matches “US SMB payroll + benefits + light HR — Simple from $49/mo + $6/person; Plus $80 + $12; Pre” rather than Oracle Cloud HCM's shape. Choose Oracle Cloud HCM only if your buying job matches “Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM — modular enterprise suite (Global HR, payroll, talent, WFM); cust” rather than Gusto's shape. Workflow advantage: Gusto leans payroll-benefits, core-hris; Oracle Cloud HCM leans enterprise-hcm. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in hr, but documented company-size audiences diverge.
- Positioning: Gusto is US SMB payroll + benefits + light HR — Simple from $49/mo + $6/person; Plus $80 + $12; Premium $180 + $22.; Oracle Cloud HCM is Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM — modular enterprise suite (Global HR, payroll, talent, WFM); custom quote, no published PEPM..
- Company-size focus: Gusto (micro, small-business) vs Oracle Cloud HCM (enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Gusto-leaning payroll-benefits, core-hris vs Oracle Cloud HCM-leaning enterprise-hcm.
- Researched limits: Gusto — Simple plan is single-state payroll — multi-state needs Plus; Oracle Cloud HCM — No published list price.

Limitations — Gusto: Simple plan is single-state payroll — multi-state needs Plus; People/HRIS depth is light versus BambooHR; Gusto is payroll-first; Oracle Cloud HCM: No published list price; Oracle Cloud / Fusion stack gravity — not a lightweight SMB HRIS.

Poor-fit cases: Gusto is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Simple plan is single-state payroll — multi-state needs Plus · Oracle Cloud HCM is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published list price · Avoid Gusto if you actually need Oracle Cloud HCM's motion (Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM — modular enterprise suite (Global HR, payroll, talent, )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
